properties.title: Severe Thunderstorm Warning issued September 12 at 10:54AM CDT until September 12 at 11:45AM CDT by NWS Omaha/Valley NE
properties.description:
SVROAX

The National Weather Service in Omaha has issued a

* Severe Thunderstorm Warning for...
Western Pawnee County in southeastern Nebraska...
Central Gage County in southeastern Nebraska...

* Until 1145 AM CDT.

* At 1053 AM CDT, a severe thunderstorm was located 3 miles east of
Beatrice, moving southeast at 35 mph.

HAZARD...Quarter size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Damage to vehicles is expected.

* This severe thunderstorm will be near...
Holmesville around 1100 AM CDT.
Virginia around 1105 AM CDT.

Other locations in the path of this severe thunderstorm include
Burchard.
properties.instruction:
For your protection move to an interior room on the lowest floor of a
building.

properties.title: Special Marine Warning issued September 12 at 11:52AM EDT until September 12 at 1:45PM EDT by NWS Tallahassee FL
properties.description:
SMWTAE

The National Weather Service in Tallahassee has issued a

* Special Marine Warning for...
Apalachee Bay or Coastal Waters From Keaton Beach to Ochlockonee
River Fl out to 20 Nm...
Coastal Waters From  Ochlockonee River to Apalachicola FL out to 20
Nm...
Coastal waters from  Suwannee River to Keaton Beach out 20 NM...
Waters from Suwannee River to Apalachicola FL from 20 to 60 NM...

* Until 145 PM EDT.

* At 1151 AM EDT, a cluster of strong thunderstorms capable of
producing waterspouts were located along a line extending from 8
nm north of O Tower to near Suwannee River, moving east at 25
knots.

HAZARD...Waterspouts and wind gusts 34 knots or greater.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Waterspouts can quickly form and capsize boats...damage
vessels...and create suddenly higher waves. Make sure all
on board are in a secure location and wearing life
jackets. Expect wind gusts in excess of 34
knots...suddenly higher waves...frequent lightning...and
heavy downpours. Make sure all on board are wearing life
jackets.

* Locations impacted include...
Buckeye Reef, Horseshoe Beach, K Tower, Marker 24 Barge, and
Suwannee River.
properties.instruction: Move to safe harbor until hazardous weather passes.
properties.area: Apalachee Bay or Coastal Waters From Keaton Beach to Ochlockonee River Fl out to 20 Nm; Coastal Waters From  Ochlockonee River to Apalachicola FL out to 20 Nm; Coastal waters from  Suwannee River to Keaton Beach out 20 NM; Waters from Suwannee River to Apalachicola FL from 20 to 60 NM

properties.title: Special Weather Statement issued September 12 at 10:50AM CDT by NWS Norman OK
properties.description:
At 1050 AM CDT, Doppler radar was tracking a strong thunderstorm near
Marland, moving southeast at 10 mph.

HAZARD...Wind gusts up to 50 mph and nickel size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Gusty winds could knock down tree limbs and blow around
unsecured objects. Minor damage to outdoor objects is
possible.

Locations impacted include...
Red Rock and Marland.
properties.instruction: If outdoors, consider seeking shelter inside a building.

properties.title: Special Weather Statement issued September 12 at 10:42AM CDT by NWS North Platte NE
properties.description:
At 1042 AM CDT, Doppler radar was tracking a strong thunderstorm 7
miles north of Medicine Creek Reservoir State Recreation Area, or 16
miles southeast of Curtis, moving east at 30 mph.

HAZARD...Wind gusts up to 40 mph and nickel size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Gusty winds could knock down tree limbs and blow around
unsecured objects. Minor hail damage to vegetation is
possible.

Locations impacted include...
Orafino.
properties.instruction: If outdoors, consider seeking shelter inside a building.

properties.title: Special Weather Statement issued September 12 at 10:39AM CDT by NWS Huntsville AL
properties.description:
At 1039 AM CDT, Doppler radar was tracking a strong thunderstorm near
J P Coleman State Park, moving east at 25 mph.

HAZARD...Wind gusts up to 40 mph.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Gusty winds could knock down tree limbs and blow around
unsecured objects.

Locations impacted include...
Florence, Muscle Shoals, Sheffield, Tuscumbia, Cherokee, St. Florian,
Underwood-Petersville, Waterloo, Riverton, and Wright.
properties.instruction:
If outdoors, consider seeking shelter inside a building.

If on or near Pickwick Lake, get out of the water and move indoors
or inside a vehicle. Remember, lightning can strike out to 10 miles
from the parent thunderstorm. If you can hear thunder, you are close
enough to be struck by lightning. Move to safe shelter now! Do not
be caught on the water in a thunderstorm.

properties.title: Special Weather Statement issued September 12 at 10:37AM CDT by NWS Omaha/Valley NE
properties.description:
At 1036 AM CDT, broadcast media reported a cluster of strong
thunderstorms along a line extending from near Eagle to 4 miles east
of Douglas to 3 miles west of Sterling. Movement was east at 30 mph.

HAZARD...Pea to Penny size hail. Rainfall rates of 1" per hour.

SOURCE...Broadcast media.

IMPACT...Minor hail damage to vegetation is possible.

* Locations impacted include...
Southeastern Lincoln, Syracuse, Hickman, Bennet, Firth, Palmyra,
Sterling, Johnson, Cook, Unadilla, Panama, Talmage, Roca, Dunbar,
Douglas, Brock, Lorton, Otoe, Burr, and St Mary.
properties.instruction:
If outdoors, consider seeking shelter inside a building.

Torrential rainfall is also occurring with these storms and may lead
to localized flooding. Do not drive your vehicle through flooded
roadways.

properties.title: Flash Flood Warning issued September 12 at 9:39AM EDT until September 12 at 3:45PM EDT by NWS Peachtree City GA
properties.description:
FFWFFC

The National Weather Service in Peachtree City has issued a

* Flash Flood Warning for...
Southeastern Cobb County in north central Georgia...
Northwestern DeKalb County in north central Georgia...
Northeastern Douglas County in north central Georgia...
Central Fulton County in north central Georgia...

* Until 345 PM EDT Saturday.

* At 939 AM EDT, Doppler radar indicated thunderstorms producing
heavy rain across the warned area. Between 1 and 3 inches of rain
have fallen. Additional rainfall amounts of 1 to 2 inches are
possible in the warned area. Flash flooding is ongoing or expected
to begin shortly.

HAZARD...Flash flooding caused by thunderstorms.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Flash flooding of small creeks and streams, urban areas,
highways, streets and underpasses as well as other poor
drainage and low-lying areas.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Atlanta, Marietta, Douglasville, City of South Fulton, Sandy
Springs, Smyrna, Dunwoody, East Point, Chamblee, Doraville,
Midtown, North Druid Hills, North Atlanta, Bolton, Bankhead,
Vinings and Cascade Heights.
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.
properties.area: Cobb, GA; DeKalb, GA; Douglas, GA; Fulton, GA
